name: Morale
author: Alexandria
summary: Monsters and NPCs may flee or surrender when the fight turns against them.

rules.text: A creature or group may **flee or surrender** when it is surprised, its leader falls, it drops to half its hit points with no way to win, or most of its side is down. The GM calls for a **DC 10 Wisdom save**; on a failure it runs, hides or gives up. Mindless creatures and fanatics never check.

assistant.dm: Morale is on: when an enemy is surprised, loses its leader, falls to half HP with no way to win, or most of its side is down, roll a DC 10 Wisdom save for it; on a failure it flees or surrenders. Skip mindless creatures and fanatics. Suggest this when a fight is clearly won.
assistant.player: Enemies at this table may run or surrender when a fight goes badly for them, so taking prisoners and scaring foes off can work.
